history.summary: Hilltop Vaishnava shrine at Gudem village (Dandepally mandal), on a hill overlooking the Godavari, about 40 km from Mancherial. Presiding deity is Vishnu worshipped as Satyanarayana Swamy with consort Lakshmi as Rama Devi; the complex also has an Ayyappa shrine and ~220 steps to the sanctum. Popularly called the 'Annavaram of Telangana'. Karthika Masam (Oct-Nov) draws the largest crowds, when devotees take a holy dip in the Godavari and perform Satyanarayana Vratam. CSV town 'Adilabad' corrected: actual town is Gudem village; Dandepally mandal lies in Mancherial district (carved out of Adilabad in 2016). CSV state 'Adilabad' corrected: Telangana. CONFLICT: sources disagree on opening hours (6:00 AM-9:00 AM & 5:30-8:00 PM vs 8:30 AM-10:00 PM vs 9:00 AM-5:00 PM) and on distance from Mancherial (32-40 km) - verify locally.

name: Gudem Satyana Narayana Swamy Temple
town_description: Gudem is a village in Dandepally mandal of Mancherial district, Telangana, set on the banks of the Godavari on the Karimnagar-Adilabad border belt. Its claim to fame is the Gudem Gutta hilltop Satyanarayana Swamy temple, reached by road from Mancherial (about 32-40 km), Luxettipet (about 7 km) and Karimnagar (about 61 km).

travel.airport: Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad (about 226-260 km; sources differ)
travel.road: Buses from Mancherial (about 32 km), Luxettipet (about 7 km) and Karimnagar (about 61 km); Hyderabad about 226 km

visitor_information.best_time: October to February; Karthika Masam (October-November) is the peak season with the heaviest crowds
